title: "MSigDB Hallmark ssGSEA Pathway Activity Analysis in pILC RNA-seq Samples"
output: html_document
date: "2026-06-07"
---

# Analysis overview

This analysis performs sample-level pathway activity scoring in 31 pILC RNA-seq samples using the MSigDB Hallmark gene sets.

Because all samples belong to the same biological group, pILC, this analysis does not perform DESeq2-based differential expression or classic preranked GSEA. Instead, the ssGSEA method is used to estimate pathway activity for each Hallmark gene set in each sample.

The workflow is:

```text
log2TPM expression matrix
        ↓
confirm gene-symbol format
        ↓
load MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
        ↓
check gene overlap
        ↓
run ssGSEA using GSVA
        ↓
save Hallmark pathway score matrix
        ↓
extract DNA repair / DDR-related Hallmark programs
        ↓
plot heatmap, bubble plot, and sample-level DDR score
```

# Set up R environment

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(

```
# Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(GSVA)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Define input and output paths

```{r paths}
WORK_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Updated/Hallmark_ssGSEA"

log2tpm_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/Max_TPM/tpm_matrix_pILC_log2TPM.txt"
```

# Read log2TPM expression matrix

```{r read-expression}
expr_dt <- fread(log2tpm_file)

dim(expr_dt)
head(expr_dt[, 1:5])
```

The first column should contain gene symbols.

```{r build-expression-matrix}
gene_col <- colnames(expr_dt)[1]

gene_ids <- as.character(expr_dt[[gene_col]])

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_dt[, -1, with = FALSE])
mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_ids

dim(expr_mat)
head(rownames(expr_mat), 20)
```

# Clean expression matrix

```{r clean-expression}
expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  !is.na(rownames(expr_mat_annot)) &
    rownames(expr_mat_annot) != "",
]

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  rowSums(is.finite(expr_mat_annot)) == ncol(expr_mat_annot),
]

dim(expr_mat_annot)
```

# Remove duplicated gene symbols

If duplicated gene symbols exist, keep the row with the highest average expression.

```{r remove-duplicated-symbols}
gene_mean <- rowMeans(expr_mat_annot, na.rm = TRUE)

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  order(rownames(expr_mat_annot), -gene_mean),
]

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  !duplicated(rownames(expr_mat_annot)),
]

dim(expr_mat_annot)
head(rownames(expr_mat_annot))
```

# Save cleaned expression matrix

```{r save-clean-expression}
clean_expr_file <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "pILC_log2TPM_gene_symbol_matrix_for_Hallmark_ssGSEA.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  data.table(
    gene_symbol = rownames(expr_mat_annot),
    expr_mat_annot
  ),
  clean_expr_file,
  sep = "\t"
)

clean_expr_file
```

# Load MSigDB Hallmark gene sets

```{r load-hallmark}
get_hallmark_sets <- function() {
  
  hallmark_sets <- tryCatch(
    {
      msigdbr(
        species = "Homo sapiens",
        collection = "H"
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Trying older msigdbr syntax...")
      msigdbr(
        species = "Homo sapiens",
        category = "H"
      )
    }
  )
  
  return(hallmark_sets)
}

hallmark_sets <- get_hallmark_sets()

dim(hallmark_sets)
head(hallmark_sets)
```

Create Hallmark pathway list.

```{r create-hallmark-list}
hallmark_pathways <- split(
  hallmark_sets$gene_symbol,
  hallmark_sets$gs_name
)

hallmark_pathways <- lapply(
  hallmark_pathways,
  unique
)

length(hallmark_pathways)
head(names(hallmark_pathways), 20)
```

Expected number of Hallmark gene sets is around 50.

# Check overlap between expression genes and Hallmark genes

```{r hallmark-gene-overlap}
all_hallmark_genes <- unique(unlist(hallmark_pathways))

overlap_hallmark_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(expr_mat_annot),
  all_hallmark_genes
)

length(overlap_hallmark_genes)
length(overlap_hallmark_genes) / length(all_hallmark_genes)

head(overlap_hallmark_genes, 20)
```

# Run Hallmark ssGSEA using GSVA

This produces a pathway-by-sample matrix.

Rows = Hallmark pathways
Columns = pILC samples
Values = ssGSEA pathway activity scores

```{r run-hallmark-ssgsea}
run_ssgsea <- function(expr_mat, pathway_list) {
  
  if ("ssgseaParam" %in% getNamespaceExports("GSVA")) {
    
    message("Using newer GSVA syntax with ssgseaParam()")
    
    ssgsea_param <- ssgseaParam(
      exprData = expr_mat,
      geneSets = pathway_list,
      minSize = 10,
      maxSize = 500
    )
    
    scores <- gsva(ssgsea_param)
    
  } else {
    
    message("Using older GSVA syntax")
    
    scores <- gsva(
      expr = expr_mat,
      gset.idx.list = pathway_list,
      method = "ssgsea",
      min.sz = 10,
      max.sz = 500,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  return(scores)
}

hallmark_ssgsea_scores <- run_ssgsea(
  expr_mat = expr_mat_annot,
  pathway_list = hallmark_pathways
)

dim(hallmark_ssgsea_scores)
hallmark_ssgsea_scores[1:5, 1:5]
```

# Save Hallmark ssGSEA score matrix

```{r save-hallmark-scores}
hallmark_ssgsea_out <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "pILC_Hallmark_ssGSEA_pathway_scores.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  data.table(
    pathway = rownames(hallmark_ssgsea_scores),
    hallmark_ssgsea_scores
  ),
  hallmark_ssgsea_out,
  sep = "\t"
)

hallmark_ssgsea_out
```

# Plot all Hallmark pathways as heatmap

Because Hallmark contains a compact set of pathways, all pathways can be shown together.

```{r hallmark-all-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=11}
hallmark_z <- t(scale(t(hallmark_ssgsea_scores)))

rownames(hallmark_z) <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", rownames(hallmark_z))
rownames(hallmark_z) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(hallmark_z))

pheatmap(
  hallmark_z,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  main = "MSigDB Hallmark pathway activity across pILC samples"
)
```

Save heatmap.

```{r save-hallmark-all-heatmap}
hallmark_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  PLOT_DIR,
  "pILC_Hallmark_ssGSEA_all_pathways_heatmap.pdf"
)

pdf(hallmark_heatmap_file, width = 10, height = 11)

pheatmap(
  hallmark_z,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  main = "MSigDB Hallmark pathway activity across pILC samples"
)

dev.off()

hallmark_heatmap_file
```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bubble plot summary for all Hallmark pathways
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_fraction <- 0.25

high_hallmark_mat <- apply(
  hallmark_ssgsea_scores,
  2,
  function(x) {
    cutoff <- quantile(x, probs = 1 - top_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
    x >= cutoff
  }
)

high_hallmark_mat <- as.matrix(high_hallmark_mat)
rownames(high_hallmark_mat) <- rownames(hallmark_ssgsea_scores)
colnames(high_hallmark_mat) <- colnames(hallmark_ssgsea_scores)

hallmark_bubble_df <- data.frame(
  pathway = rownames(hallmark_ssgsea_scores),
  mean_score = rowMeans(hallmark_ssgsea_scores, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_score = apply(hallmark_ssgsea_scores, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_score = apply(hallmark_ssgsea_scores, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_samples_high = rowSums(high_hallmark_mat),
  percent_samples_high = rowSums(high_hallmark_mat) / ncol(hallmark_ssgsea_scores) * 100,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

hallmark_bubble_df <- hallmark_bubble_df[
  order(-hallmark_bubble_df$median_score),
]

hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean <- hallmark_bubble_df$pathway
hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean)
hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean <- gsub("_", " ", hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean)

head(hallmark_bubble_df, 20)
```
```{r}
top_n <- 20

top_hallmark_bubble_df <- head(hallmark_bubble_df, top_n)

top_hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean <- factor(
  top_hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean,
  levels = rev(top_hallmark_bubble_df$pathway_clean)
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

p_hallmark_bubble <- ggplot(
  top_hallmark_bubble_df,
  aes(
    x = median_score,
    y = pathway_clean,
    size = percent_samples_high,
    color = median_score
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Hallmark ssGSEA pathway activity across pILC samples",
    x = "Median ssGSEA score",
    y = "Hallmark pathway",
    size = "Samples high (%)",
    color = "Median score"
  )

p_hallmark_bubble
```
```{r}
hallmark_bubble_pdf <- file.path(
  PLOT_DIR,
  "pILC_Hallmark_ssGSEA_top_pathways_bubbleplot.pdf"
)

hallmark_bubble_png <- file.path(
  PLOT_DIR,
  "pILC_Hallmark_ssGSEA_top_pathways_bubbleplot.png"

ggsave(

ggsave(

)

hallmark_bubble_pdf
hallmark_bubble_png
```
